findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded when `I18n.translate` is called outside `ApplicationController` or with `:locale`
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only invoked in `ApplicationController#set_locale`, while `I18n.translate` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)`. Because `translate_accelerator.rb` overrides `I18n::Backend::Base#load_translations` to prevent automatic loading of all locale files, any `I18n.t` call made outside a controller action (such as in Sidekiq jobs, `UserNotifications` mailers, rake tasks, or specs) or after `I18n.reload!` will not have `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `:en` loaded in the backend, so fallback lookups will fail with `translation missing`. Furthermore, for zero-argument `I18n.t(key)` calls, `@cache.getset(k)` at line 74 will cache the `"translation missing: ..."` result, poisoning subsequent controller requests as well. Calling `I18n.t(key, locale: other_locale)` also fails to load `other_locale` and its fallbacks. `I18n.translate` (or `load_locale`) should ensure the requested locale and all of its `I18n.fallbacks` are loaded.

findings.title: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` does not convert `locale` to a Symbol before deduplicating
findings.body: In `FallbackLocaleList#[](locale)`, `locale` is combined with Symbol locales in `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` without converting `locale` to a Symbol. While `I18n.locale` is a Symbol, `I18n.translate(key, locale: ...)` passes `options[:locale]` directly to the backend without calling `.to_sym` (and methods like `SiteSetting.default_locale` and `User#effective_locale` return Strings). When `locale` is a String such as `"en"`, `["en", :en, :en].uniq` returns `["en", :en]` instead of `[:en]`, causing redundant fallback lookups and mismatches with Symbol entries in `@loaded_locales`.

findings.title: No tests covering server-side locale fallbacks
findings.body: This PR introduces `FallbackLocaleList` and lazy loading for fallback locales in `translate_accelerator.rb` without any test coverage verifying that missing translations fall back from the active locale to `SiteSetting.default_locale` and then to `:en`.
